title: rolling craft tote
text: rolling craft tote. I do diamond painting and i was looking for a a rolling tote to store and access my diamond painting craft supplies and projects.  This works.  I chose the grayish color - has a white trim.  The handle doesn't lock up - so you can't lean on it as it will collapse.  The main box is empty - no organizers of any kind - good for my purpose.  There are 3 outside zippered pouches... they are flat -  so you would store thinner supplies in these - one wider one in the front and 2 smaller pouches on the sides. The widest zipper pouch - in the front also has an open slide in pouch in front of the zippered pouch.  It seems to be fairly well made - Time will tell.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
